doc_sources.note: ROBOTS-BLOCKED FOR OUR FETCHER. Denis's ruling 2026-08-20: reachable by a human, or by an independent Playwright session run deliberately outside the pipeline -- never by the automated fetcher. Authored as kind:"portal" precisely because DISCOVER only ever prefills a manual task from a portal source and never enqueues fetch.url for it. robots.txt carries `Disallow: /*.pdf` (also .xlsx/.doc/.docx and /fileadmin/user_upload/downloads/Handel/*), so every document on the domain is off limits to a crawler while the HTML listing itself is not. Fetched 2026-08-20, HTTP 200. The page is fully static and names Declaration of conformity, ISO 13485, MDSAP and EU QMS certificates, safety data sheets and studies. FILENAMES CARRY REF NUMBERS -- REF078, REF_062, REF%20377, REF_A20, plus Rev_002 revision tokens; three separator forms (glued, underscored, URL-encoded space) so any pattern must tolerate all three. The DoC filename also carries its own validity date (Konformitaetserklaerung__MDR__priti_Stand_2024-05-31.pdf). This is the highest-value filename signal in the whole sweep and it is the one we may not fetch. Legal entity confirmed against their own legal notice, and it corroborates the offline lead: GC's own spreadsheet in our corpus names "Pritidenta GmbH" as legal manufacturer of 76 GC articles.
Free paper-IFU request within 7 days, Fetched 2026-08-20, HTTP 200. A viable email.request route given the robots block on PDFs.
